statement: Leading README with the fixture score command produces a receipt on a Deponent-free clone, whereas the current deponent.badge path cannot.
baseline: python3 -m deponent.badge verify exits 1 (no deponent); README has no gak_conformance command.
proposed_change: Document and implement python3 -m gak_conformance score --adapter <fixture>.
predicted_outcome: Clean-clone help+fixture score exits 0 and writes §5.1 JSON.
test_method: Subprocess score with deponent unimportable; compare to baseline-runtime.json.
result: selfcheck + fixture score exit 0 with deponent unimportable; README leads with python3 -m gak_conformance.

statement: Owning the 13-clause v1 table in this repo prevents Deponent extras from becoming the de facto standard.
baseline: Sibling deponent/conformance.py lists 16 clauses including REDIRECT-DENIED and NEWLINE-CHAINED.
proposed_change: In-repo CLAUSES is exactly spec §4; extras never imported.
predicted_outcome: Default score receipts never contain those two IDs.
test_method: Clause census unit test + comparison to clause-census-drift.json.
result: CLAUSES_V1 is 13 spec ids; FORBIDDEN_HARNESS_IDS absent; tests/test_clause_census.py.

statement: Explicit module:Class loading is enough for v0; a plugin directory or entry-point group adds attack surface without user value.
baseline: No loader exists.
proposed_change: importlib a single module:Class token only.
predicted_outcome: Authors can score from a local file via PYTHONPATH; no directory scan.
test_method: Load fixture by token; refuse path traversal / pickle.
result: load.py accepts only module:Class; filesystem paths rejected; no plugin dir.

statement: Stdlib argparse + json + hashlib is sufficient; third-party CLI frameworks are unnecessary.
baseline: No package, no dependencies.
proposed_change: Implement CLI and receipt in stdlib only.
predicted_outcome: pyproject runtime dependencies empty; help/score/digest work.
test_method: Import scan of gak_conformance for third-party packages; help smoke.
result: pyproject dependencies=[]; runtime is argparse/json/hashlib/importlib.

statement: Defaulting the CLI to v1 (13 clauses) rather than v1.1 reduces first-run confusion and keeps published de6b7089… as the worked value.
baseline: README mixes v1 digest and v1.1 status.
proposed_change: Default harness gak-conformance/v1; v1.1 opt-in flag later.
predicted_outcome: First fixture receipt has 13 clauses; digest algorithm matches Appendix A.
result: CLI default harness is gak-conformance/v1; selfcheck receipt has 13 clauses.

statement: Contract-honest fixtures are the right first-run path; they must be labeled harness fixtures, not third-party kernel verdicts.
baseline: No fixtures; README points at Deponent self-score.
proposed_change: Ship PassingActionAdapter / PassingCommitAdapter / Brick* as fixtures.
predicted_outcome: Selfcheck uses fixtures; README says they test the harness.
result: fixtures package and --help label fixtures as harness tests, not kernel certifications.

statement: Rewriting check_consistency against the in-repo clause table unblocks CI without Deponent and avoids inheriting Deponent extras.
baseline: check_consistency exits 3 (cannot check) when deponent missing.
proposed_change: Compare spec.md + evidence + gak_conformance.clauses.
predicted_outcome: Exit 0 when spec, in-repo table, and published v1 digest agree.
test_method: Run checker in this env after rewrite.
result: scripts/check_consistency.py exits 0 without deponent; no deponent imports.

statement: A dedicated `digest --receipt` command is clearer than forcing a full score to check published evidence.
baseline: No command; digest was only inside deponent.badge.
proposed_change: Add digest subcommand.
predicted_outcome: Operators re-derive de6b7089… from the checked-in receipt in one command.
result: digest --receipt prints de6b7089… exit 0.

statement: Stating adapter import-exec risk in --help increases trust versus hiding it.
baseline: No CLI.
proposed_change: Help documents that --adapter imports Python and fixtures are not kernel certifications.
predicted_outcome: Independent security review does not file 'undisclosed code exec' as a surprise.
test_method: Security lane review of help text.
result: --help states adapter import executes the module.

statement: Using compact JSON separators for the digest would break the published v1 digest and must be rejected.
baseline: Published digest de6b7089…; common advice is compact canonical JSON.
proposed_change: Implement spec §5.3 default separators only.
predicted_outcome: Default encoding matches published digest; compact encoding differs.
test_method: Hash both encodings of the published receipt body.
result: Measured 2026-08-12: default separators → de6b7089… (match); compact → 65f40400… (mismatch). Keep default separators. See EVID-DIGEST-SEPARATOR.

statement: score + digest --receipt is not enough for spec §5.4; operators need verify that re-runs the kernel.
baseline: CLI had score/digest/selfcheck only; digest hashes a file.
proposed_change: Add verify --adapter --cert.
predicted_outcome: Stale digest exits 1 even if live kernel is conformant; matching cert exits 0.
result: Implemented. Matching fixture cert exits 0; mutated digest exits 1; brick vs conformant cert exits 1.

statement: A named pip extra deponent would look like the kernel owns the standard.
baseline: No extra.
proposed_change: Do not add [project.optional-dependencies] deponent; use find_spec + ImportError.
predicted_outcome: Core install stays vendor-neutral; absent Deponent is exit 2.
result: No deponent extra. Adapter module imports cleanly; construction without Deponent raises ImportError; CLI exit 2.

statement: importlib.util.find_spec is a presence probe, not a sandbox.
baseline: No optional adapter.
proposed_change: Probe find_spec("deponent"); load via string import_module only in __init__.
predicted_outcome: import gak_conformance.adapters.deponent does not put deponent in sys.modules.
result: Measured: deponent not in sys.modules after importing the adapter module.

statement: Raw exception messages in receipt detail leak host home paths (CWE-209) while spec §6.3 still needs type+message.
baseline: detail used f"{type}: {exc}".
proposed_change: Redact /Users/<name> /home/<name> Windows user paths to <path>.
predicted_outcome: Type remains; contiguous /Users/cj absent from detail.
result: FileNotFoundError kept; /Users/cj redacted to <path>.

statement: Full REUSE 3.3 annotation of every file is not required for an Apache-2.0 research-prototype zip.
baseline: LICENSE + NOTICE already present.
proposed_change: Keep LICENSE/NOTICE; migrate PEP 639; skip reuse lint as a gate.
predicted_outcome: Release zip includes LICENSE and NOTICE; Apache §4d satisfied without SPDX headers on every file.
test_method: zip namelist contains LICENSE and NOTICE
result: Zip includes LICENSE and NOTICE. REUSE lint not run and not a gate.

statement: Documenting repository-root invocation is enough for first-run; a second CLI or required PYTHONPATH is unnecessary.
baseline: README said 'from a clone' but not repository root; /tmp cwd failed with No module named gak_conformance.
proposed_change: Name repository root in Sequence A; test empty cwd fail and clean-tree success.
predicted_outcome: Stranger following README from repo root gets help+selfcheck; wrong cwd is an explained failure.
result: Measured 2026-08-12: repo-root help exit 0; empty cwd exit 1 with No module named gak_conformance; clean copy of gak_conformance/ selfchecks.

statement: Putting the bounded claim in the first 40 lines does not bury Sequence A.
baseline: Bound sat at README line 56, after digest trivia and Sequence B.
proposed_change: Bound + research prototype immediately after the one-line what, then Sequence A.
predicted_outcome: First 40 lines contain both the bound and the fixture commands.
result: First 40 lines contain research prototype, not secure/audited/endorsed, repository root, and Sequence A.

statement: A HARNESS_OK stderr banner is less mark-like than dumping only JSON with conformant:true or printing CONFORMANT via render().
baseline: selfcheck reused cmd_score; --out printed CONFORMANT; stderr was 'digest <hex>'.
proposed_change: Dedicated selfcheck writer; HARNESS_OK + not a kernel certification; no render banner.
predicted_outcome: selfcheck never emits GAK-conformant; stderr names HARNESS_OK.
result: stderr is HARNESS_OK fixture=fixture-action digest=9949c515… (not a kernel certification).

statement: A raising adapter skeleton is a better Journey B start than sending authors only to spec §6.
baseline: No examples/; README said implement spec §6.
proposed_change: Ship examples/adapter_skeleton.py that raises NotImplementedError.
predicted_outcome: Untouched skeleton is not conformant; README links it.
result: run_conformance(YourKernelAdapter()) is conformant=false with FAIL clauses.

statement: Retargeting spec §7.1 and Appendix A/B commands to gak_conformance does not change the frozen v1 digest.
baseline: §7.1 imported deponent.conformance; Appendix A used deponent.badge verify.
proposed_change: D-007 docs-only retarget. Keep §4/§5/digest.
predicted_outcome: check_consistency exit 0; de6b7089… still in spec.
result: CONSISTENT: 13 clauses; digest de6b7089… preserved; first §7.1 fence imports gak_conformance.
